component.name: nuxeo.labs.workflowgraph.webresources
component.documentation:
Registers the plugin's entry point with the Web UI bundle, so Web UI loads it at startup (nuxeo.war/ui/config.jsp lists every resource of type "import" of the "web-ui" bundle).
The type="import" attribute is mandatory: without it, the type would be inferred from the file extension ("html") and config.jsp would silently ignore the resource.
No require on org.nuxeo.web.ui here: inside a component, require names a component, and no component has that name (it is the bundle symbolic name). The component would stay pending and the server would refuse to start in strict mode. An append="true" contribution is never lost, whatever the registration order.
@since 2025.1
